channel.name: Tea Break with Manoj
channel.note: The owner's choice (22 Nov 2026): the office stories go on the Tea Break channel, in their own playlist, a little funny.

languages_note: The owner's wish (22 Nov 2026: 'We use both English and Tamil also'): every office story goes out twice on the same day, Tamil at publish_time and English at publish_time_en (India time).
style: Hand-drawn doodle cartoon illustration, flat colours, clean black ink outlines, warm cream paper background, soft shadows, relatable and a little funny, Indian office life in Chennai. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
queue_note: The owner's first-week plan (22 Nov 2026): one worry a day - freshers (24 Nov), credit-stealing (25), appraisal budget (26), the 'quick call' (27), quiet-exit signs (28), Diwali on a US calendar (29). A run takes the first point here not yet used; when all are used it picks by trends.py and points.json.
